crop_image_by_bbox: crop an image using center and scale parameters and resize to 224x224 resolution
process_image_from_keypoints: process an image by cropping around detected 2D keypoints and returning normalized tensor output
process_image_from_bbox: process an image by cropping around a bounding box and returning normalized tensor output
convert_bbox_format: convert between center-scale and top-left-bottom-right bounding box coordinate formats
denormalize_image_tensor: denormalize a batch of normalized image tensors back to original uint8 numpy array format
